CustomField.description: Widened Text(255) -> LongTextArea(32768) to match Order_Form_Extraction__c.Subprocessor_Restrictions__c. ContractLegalTermsApplier copies the OFE value here verbatim; a multi-clause restriction (e.g. Macquarie) exceeds 255 and would throw STRING_TOO_LONG against the old Text field. Not filtered/reported on, so the in-place conversion is data-preserving and safe.
CustomField.label: Subprocessor Restrictions
